'''Dan's father''' (Japanese: '''ダンの父''' ''Dan's father'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW003|A Sandile Gusher of Change!]]''.

Dan's father owns a spa resort on {{Rt|1|Unova}}, which is famous for its sand baths. He works there with his son {{OBP|Dan|BW003}}. He first appeared in a flashback, where Dan told {{Ash}} and {{an|Iris}} about the {{p|Sandile}} incident that had been occurring quite often for a few days, which has been scaring customers away.

Later, Ash, Iris, and Dan found out that the reason the Sandile were scaring the people away was that the geysers were dangerously close to erupting. Soon after, it was revealed that the geysers had done more good than harm and put Dan and his father back in business with a brand-new hot spring, which he treated Ash and Iris to.
